name: Gielow (Germany)
description: Orange field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Gielow (an inverted yellow horseshoe and a crozier on green), occupying two thirds of the height.
history: The arms were approved on 28 May 2003 and the flag on 3 July 2003 by the Ministry of the Interior.

features.role: Gielow arms — horseshoe and crozier on green
